proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / FY2011 COLLECTION OF TAXES`, PDF page 78 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folio 75). 49 receivable rows against a printed `GRAND TOTAL`. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER (rule 13b.4): `COLLECTION OF TAXES` | `FORWARD` | `COMMITTMENTS` | `ADJUSTMENTS` | `REFUNDS` | `PAYMENTS` | `ABATEMENTS` | `TRANSFER` | `BALANCES`. `COMMITTMENTS` is spelt with two Ts on the page and is recorded as printed, never corrected. WHAT PROVES IT, twice over. (1) ALL EIGHT money columns foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL to the cent with NO tolerance: 1,520,280.74 / 20,901,570.69 / (198,957.22) / 26,258.46 / (20,207,288.18) / (176,592.45) / (284,631.85) / 1,580,640.19. (2) EVERY ONE OF THE 49 ROWS closes on the identity the table states about itself, forward plus committments plus adjustments plus refunds plus payments plus abatements plus transfer equals the balance carried -- declared here as a `row_identity` and re-asserted on every run. THE ROW-TO-FIGURE ALIGNMENT IS FIXED BY ARITHMETIC, NOT BY THE LOOK OF THE PAGE, AND THAT MATTERS HERE MORE THAN ANYWHERE. The scan is sheared: the `BALANCES` column is printed roughly one row pitch BELOW the label it belongs to, and the drift grows left to right, so on the personal-property block the `PAYMENTS` cells appear a row low as well. Read by eye the table would assign 1997 MVE's balance to 1998 MVE and every row after it. Each pairing here was settled by the row identity and then by the eight column totals, which is FY2014 page 42's lesson applied -- an independent total decides an alignment, never the appearance of one. A single mis-assigned row breaks both proofs at once: the columns would still foot (the figures are all present) but 49 row identities would not. SIGNS ARE THE DOCUMENT'S. Payments, abatements, transfers and adjustments print in PARENTHESES and are recorded negative, which is why the identity is a pure sum. Two cells break that pattern and are recorded POSITIVE because the page prints them without parentheses: 2008 RE payments 42.38 and 2009 RE payments 686.75. Three FORWARD cells are themselves negative -- 2008 RE (5,826.88), 2009 RE (3,844.22) and STR BETT COMM (295.61) -- and so are five balances. Read as positives no column would foot. ROWS ARE KEYED BY THE PRINTED LABEL, which is unique down this page; no label repeats. A blank cell is recorded as no value rather than 0.00; a cell printing `$ -` is recorded as 0.00, which is what 2011 MVE, 2011 PP, 2011 RE, ROLLBACK TAXES, SEPTIC BETT COMM and SEPTIC INT COMM print in the forward column. WHAT THIS IS. A receivable ledger: what the town was owed at the start of FY2011, what it committed, what it collected and what it was still owed at 30 June 2011. It is NOT revenue and it is not the levy -- the 2011 RE committment of 17,731,543.03 is the real-estate commitment, against a fiscal 2011 tax levy of 18,006,811.48 printed on page 12, and the difference is personal property and motor-vehicle excise, which this table commits separately. Nothing here is differenced against either.
